promotion_rule: TRL6 may be claimed only when every required gate is VERIFIED and the evidence reference is reviewable.

gates.requirement: Integrated working software is deployed with accounts, public risk checks, dashboard workflows, action guidance, evidence history and failure states.
gates.evidence_reference: Vercel preview plus authenticated browser journey; repository product contracts

gates.requirement: The complete decision loop is exercised in a relevant operational environment with an institutional design partner.
Representative household, farm, business or agency operators complete critical journeys without developer assistance.
Forecast issues and outcomes are preserved prospectively with false-alert burden, lead time and missed-event analysis.
At least one authorised operational source is connected with provenance, freshness, outage and fallback evidence.
A warning or action task is delivered to a verified recipient and records channel, language, receipt and acknowledgement.
Safety-critical Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba and Igbo templates pass independent human linguistic review.
At least one permissioned pilot record joins evidence, exposure, owner, action, delivery receipt and verified outcome.
Operators demonstrate source outage, missed delivery, official-warning precedence and escalation behavior.
An independent reviewer signs the evidence register and confirms the relevant-environment demonstration boundary.
